slides.title: Night curfew on vehicles in Mekelle
No vehicles from 8 PM to 6 AM
slides.body: Borkena reports Ethiopia's defence forces banned all vehicles in the city at night from Friday, including trucks, cars and motorcycles.

slides.title: House-to-house inspections
slides.body: Security personnel will search homes between 6 AM and 6 PM, per Borkena. Vehicles with unauthorised stickers are also banned.

slides.title: to hand in unregistered firearms
slides.body: Residents must surrender them to the Tigray Region Police Commission or face prosecution, according to the report.

slides.title: Two sides, two accounts
slides.body: Military officials cite crime and detainee releases. TPLF spokesperson Michael Asgedom rejected that claim. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Lawful, accountable searches.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
